title: ComfyUI custom-node XPU-support catalog record
description: One record per custom-node package describing its Intel-XPU support: source/storage, required changes (patches/pip/SYCL wheel/env), version support, xpu-vs-cpu execution, usable configs (reduction/launch flags), validation evidence, and trust tier. Superset of recipes/nodes/*.json (recipe.schema.json) + src/server/knownCustomNodes.ts. The catalog-server validates every write against this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Record schema version. Bump when the shape changes incompatibly.

nodeKey.description: Stable catalog key = normalized repo identity `<owner>__<repo>` lowercased, e.g. 'lihaoyun6__comfyui-llama-cpp_vlm'. One file nodes/<nodeKey>.json.

repository.description: Git repo URL cloned into <nfs>/custom_nodes/<packageName> and symlinked into the run.

nodeTypePrefixes.description: class_type prefixes this package provides. A workflow node whose type starts with any of these belongs to this package (prefix, not exact — one entry covers a node family).

onNfsShare.description: Whether this package is published on the shared /nfs_share/custom_nodes tree (symlinked per node) vs a local-only clone.

nfsPath.description: Absolute path on the shared tree, e.g. /nfs_share/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-llama-cpp_vlm.

symlinkModel.description: True when the local custom_nodes/<name> entry is a symlink to nfsPath (the shared convention).

commit.description: Pinned git commit/ref the recorded support was proven against.

versionsSupported.description: Git refs/tags/commits known to work on XPU with this record's changes.

supportedDtypes.description: Model dtypes this record's XPU support was proven for (e.g. fp8_e4m3fn, bf16). Empty/absent means any dtype.

modelSubdir.description: ComfyUI models/<modelSubdir>/ folder this node loads weights from (e.g. 'LLM'). Routes acquired assets.

execution.description: Where this node actually computes: xpu=on the Arc GPU; cpu=host CPU (e.g. llama.cpp VLM); hybrid=some ops XPU, some CPU.

xpuSupport.description: native=works out of box on XPU; patched=needs a source patch; cpu_offload=runs on CPU by design; unsupported=no known path; unknown=not yet determined.

patchClass.description: Dominant patch class for this node (from Step 02/04 audit).

patches.description: Source patches required to make this node work on XPU.

baseVersion.description: Package commit the patch was authored against.

validationCommand.description: Shell command that exits 0 if the patch achieved its goal.

backend.description: Which prebuilt backend the installed binary must target (e.g. cpu-built llama-cpp-python; xpu torch wheels).

skipRequirementsTxt.description: When true, do NOT pip install -r the node's requirements.txt (it pins CUDA/Metal wheels wrong for this box); install the backend-appropriate wheel instead.

extraWheels.description: Prebuilt wheel paths/URLs to install instead of / in addition to requirements.txt (e.g. /nfs_share/wheels/llama-cpp-python/...whl).

syclWheel.description: Whether this node needs a SYCL-backend native wheel compiled to run on XPU (vs a pure-Python patch or a CPU wheel).

buildScript.description: Repo-relative build script that compiles the SYCL wheel.

prebuiltWheelPath.description: Path to a prebuilt SYCL wheel on /nfs_share/wheels to avoid recompiling.

envVars.description: Environment variables required at launch for this node's XPU path (e.g. OMNI_FP8_KEEP_ON_MOVE=1).

runtimePolicy.description: Runtime-policy edits this node needs in the API prompt (e.g. device cuda->xpu, sage_attention disabled). Free-form key/value guidance.

providesEnumValues.description: Enum widget values this package injects into host node dropdowns (e.g. RES4LYF adds res_2s/bong_tangent). A workflow using one needs this package installed.

enumSlots.description: Host nodeType enum slots the values belong to, e.g. ['sampler_name','scheduler'].

usableConfigs.description: Configurations proven usable on XPU for this node.

launchFlags.description: ComfyUI launch flags this node was validated with (e.g. ['--reserve-vram','1','--lowvram']).

attnBackend.description: Attention backend setting (e.g. sdpa; sage_attention disabled).

reductionConfig.description: Reduced-tier knobs proven to fit (ref_max_size caps, frame caps, resolution). Free-form to match effective-run-config.recommended_reduced_setting.

knownGoodInputs.description: Minimal known-good widget inputs for this node's class_type, used to seed the per-node validation harness.

validation.description: Append-only per-run validation evidence. Each entry is one proof that this node ran (or failed) on XPU.

promptRef.description: Artifact path to the minimal prompt used.

xpuUtilizationPct.description: Peak XPU utilization sampled during the run; low => CPU-fallback suspected.

tier.description: candidate=auto-written, usable but re-validated; trusted=proven, drives deterministic no-re-audit deploy; unsupported=no XPU path.

migrationRoute.description: Triage class: how this node migrates to XPU + who acts. auto_* = agent may attempt autonomously (bounded, objective-gated); human_*/unsupported_*/not_applicable = no autonomous attempts. Orthogonal to xpuSupport (the end state). Shared vocabulary across Step 04 route, Step 02 hard_stop, and this record.

efficacy.description: Effectiveness counters, updated on each validation.

promotedBy.description: 'auto' (met promotion criteria) or a human username.

retireCondition.description: Human-readable condition under which this record is obsolete.

knownIssues.description: Concrete failure signatures, with root cause if known.

workarounds.description: Ordered steps to try, most-preferred first.

originTaskId.description: Task that first created this record.

version.description: Optimistic-lock counter. A write must carry the version it read; the server bumps it and rejects a stale write with 409.
